subject.title: fix: sharpen working-claw silhouette into a toothed pincer

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this sharper toothed-pincer silhouette as the shared working-claw visual identity across web, Apple, and Android?
rationale: The code change is mechanically narrow, but whether this silhouette is the preferred product icon treatment requires a human visual/design judgment that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the shared silhouette
options.body: Accept the new pincer artwork after a refreshed merge check confirms the three client implementations remain synchronized.

options.title: Request a revised silhouette
options.body: Keep the current rig but ask for adjusted path geometry if the new teeth or proportions do not match the intended visual language.
